---
description: Use when checking or controlling Lifetime Fleet devices, Control Room, Situation Room, missions, or device health.
---

Remote control hub for DWS IQ 6 physical infrastructure — the LWM Acer edge device, Control Room operations, and Situation Room strategic views.

Usage: /remote-control <target> [action] [input]

Input: $ARGUMENTS

## Targets

| Target | Alias | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `acer` | `lwm`, `device`, `edge` | Acer Veriton GN100 — LWM edge AI inference (Helsinki Lab) |
| `control-room` | `control`, `ops` | Operational command — fleet, sensors, field ops |
| `situation-room` | `situation`, `strategic` | Strategic command — executive, board, finance views |

## Steps

1. Parse arguments — first word is target (`acer`, `control-room`, `situation-room`), second is action, rest is input
2. Route to target:

### Target: `acer` (LWM Edge Device)
Actions:
- `status` — Check device health, GPU utilization, running containers
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"acer","action":"status"}'`
- `deploy` — Deploy a model or container to the edge device
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"acer","action":"deploy","payload":<json>}'`
- `sandbox` — Run agent in OpenSandbox (ephemeral Docker container)
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"acer","action":"sandbox","agent":"<name>","input":<json>}'`
- `logs` — Retrieve device logs (last N minutes)
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"acer","action":"logs","minutes":30}'`

### Target: `control-room` (Operational Command)
Actions:
- `status` — Live feed summary: fleet heartbeats, sensor alerts, active missions
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"control-room","action":"status"}'`
- `dispatch` — Dispatch fleet mission (routes to logistics agent)
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run logistics --input '<mission-json>'`
- `alerts` — Show unacknowledged alerts by severity
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"control-room","action":"alerts","severity":"critical"}'`
- `acknowledge` — Acknowledge an alert by ID
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"control-room","action":"acknowledge","alertId":"<id>"}'`

### Target: `situation-room` (Strategic Command)
Actions:
- `status` — Portfolio health, compliance posture, strategic risk summary
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"situation-room","action":"status"}'`
- `board-view` — Board governance overview (maps to BOARD_VIEW)
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"situation-room","action":"board-view"}'`
- `finance` — CFO/CXO financial dashboard
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run remote-control --input '{"target":"situation-room","action":"finance"}'`
- `compliance` — EU regulatory compliance posture across all business units
  - Execute: `cd cli && npx tsx src/cli.ts run compliance --input '{"scope":"enterprise"}'`

3. Present results with:
   - Device/room status indicator (online/offline/degraded)
   - Key metrics (GPU load, fleet count, alert count, compliance score)
   - Actionable recommendations if issues detected

## Examples

```
/remote-control acer status
/remote-control acer sandbox sitesense {"temperature": 35, "windSpeed": 20}
/remote-control control-room alerts critical
/remote-control control-room dispatch {"route": "Helsinki-Tampere", "cargo": "steel-beams", "urgency": "high"}
/remote-control situation-room board-view
/remote-control situation-room compliance
```

## When NOT to use

- Running a specific agent directly → use `/agent-run`
- Multi-agent workflow orchestration → use `/workflow`
- Site safety assessment only → use `/site-safety`
- Email notifications → use `/email`
